title: Histone modifications regulate pioneer transcription factor binding and cooperativity
authors: Kalyan Sinha; Silvija Bilokapic; Yongming Du; Deepshikha Malik; Mario Halic
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜结构解析Oct4与核小体复合物，揭示组蛋白修饰调控先锋转录因子结合与协同性的分子机制，属于TF-DNA互作的结构与机制研究，但方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟成分较少。
abstract: Pioneer transcription factors have the ability to access DNA in compacted chromatin. Multiple transcription factors can bind together to a regulatory element in a cooperative way and cooperation between pioneer transcription factors Oct4 and Sox2 is important for pluripotency and reprogramming. However, the molecular mechanisms by which pioneer transcription factors function and cooperate remain unclear. Here we present cryo-EM structures of human Oct4 bound to a nucleosome containing human Lin28B and nMatn1 DNA sequences, which bear multiple binding sites for Oct4. Our structural and biochemistry data reveal that Oct4 binding induces changes to the nucleosome structure, repositions the nucleosomal DNA and facilitates cooperative binding of additional Oct4 and of Sox2 to their internal binding sites. The flexible activation domain of Oct4 contacts the histone H4 N-terminal tail, altering its conformation and thus promoting chromatin decompaction. Moreover, the DNA binding domain of Oct4 engages with histone H3 N-terminal tail, and posttranslational modifications at H3K27 modulate DNA positioning and affect transcription factor cooperativity. Thus, our data show that the epigenetic landscape can regulate Oct4 activity to ensure proper cell reprogramming.
abstract_zh: 先锋转录因子具有进入致密染色质中DNA的能力。多个转录因子可以协同方式共同结合到一个调控元件上，而先锋转录因子Oct4和Sox2之间的合作对多能性和重编程至关重要。然而，先锋转录因子发挥作用及合作的分子机制仍不清楚。在此，我们展示了人类Oct4与含有多个Oct4结合位点的人类Lin28B和nMatn1 DNA序列的核小体结合的冷冻电镜结构。我们的结构和生物化学数据揭示，Oct4结合诱导核小体结构变化，重新定位核小体DNA，并促进额外的Oct4和Sox2协同结合到其内部结合位点。Oct4的柔性激活域接触组蛋白H4 N端尾部，改变其构象，从而促进染色质解压缩。此外，Oct4的DNA结合域与组蛋白H3 N端尾部相互作用，H3K27处的翻译后修饰调节DNA定位并影响转录因子协同性。因此，我们的数据表明，表观遗传景观可以调控Oct4活性，以确保正确的细胞重编程。
